title: concept change applied to one stage only
signal: a concept flag is handled in one stage only; a research reaches the acceptance stage with 0 kept rows
cause: the flag was added where the bug was seen, not traced through brief to search, screen, table, acceptance and audit
prevention: stage-trace gate: scripts/concept-trace.mjs walks brief to search, screen, table, acceptance and audit and fails when a declared stage has no handler or no test

title: invented criteria the user never asked for
signal: an enforced criterion whose source phrase is not in the request; rejection reasons naming a rule the user never stated
cause: acceptance criteria were written at implementation time instead of derived from askedCriteria
prevention: traceability gate: every enforced criterion carries the request phrase it comes from, and the enforced set is diffed against askedCriteria

title: oversized worker task, no early artifact
signal: no file written within 20 min; a src change with no matching tests/<path>.test.ts
cause: the worker spec was a whole feature, so the worker planned and wrote late and a timeout left nothing salvageable
prevention: launcher contract and watchdog: the launcher refuses a spec that does not name the src files and the matching test file, and the worker writes code and its test first

title: acting on the wrong research
signal: two researches with the same question; a created research the user did not ask for
cause: the research was identified by similarity instead of by creation time and id
prevention: resolve-by-id rule: any command taking a research id lists researches by creation time, takes the newest one the user created and prints its id and question before the run

title: two gates collide on e2e port 4610
signal: EADDRINUSE or port-in-use in the e2e output; a gate run that fails only while another gate is running
cause: the e2e port was fixed and unowned, so the commit hook gate and the harness gate could run it at the same time
prevention: exclusive lock file in os.tmpdir() (frl-quality.lock holding the pid): the second gate waits for the lock instead of failing on the port, and a stale lock is removed

title: provider saturation by background loops
signal: no new rows in the model-call ledger for N minutes while the run is in progress; provider failure rate above its bench threshold
cause: background loops and the foreground witness draw from the same free provider quota with no concurrency budget
prevention: per-provider concurrency semaphore with a reserved foreground slot: the witness runner acquires the reservation or waits with a printed reason

title: worker launch fails on missing worktree link
signal: the launcher error itself; the worktree path missing from the launcher preflight output
cause: the launcher checked the model and the spec but not the working copy it was going to run in
prevention: launcher preflight: verify the worktree path exists, is a registered git worktree of this repo and has a clean node_modules link, and refuse to start with the missing path named

title: lessons from one research leak into unrelated researches
signal: the Results tab of a plot research shows improve-loop tweaks of a clothing-supplier research (e.g. brand-filtered category pages on Vinted), and the improve prompt of one research carries another research's mixed or harmful verdicts
cause: lessons were grouped only by piece type (sub-question|lookup|fact etc.) with no item kind, and every principle verdict (helps, mixed, does not help) was rendered as an instruction to the proposer
prevention: every lesson stores the research's item kind (brief/decision-model kind label) and LessonBook.forType only returns lessons of the same type AND same kind (kindless lessons are never shared); only verdict 'helps' principles enter the playbook (helpsOnly in propose); the cross-research principles card moved from the Results tab to the Loop tab and calls /api/principles?project=<id>, filtered to the project's kind — covered by tests/research/lessons.test.ts (same-kind sharing, mixed not passed, helps passed) and tests/server.test.ts (?project= kind filter)

title: listing-work rule marks analysis pieces as covered
signal: a "pieces covered by code on the candidate table, not researched" tree line that names climate, zoning, district or data-source pieces (plot research b7772e lost 68 pieces on 2026-11-11, most of them analysis), or concept check C18 counting such pieces as per-listing work
cause: listingWork returned true for any action verb (find, identify, check, assess, calculate ...) or any target word (items, distances) on its own, so "Assess climate suitability for glamping without AC", "Identify Portuguese coastal districts" and "Assess e bike accessibility to the sea" counted as listing work and were never researched
prevention: listingWork needs an action on listings: a for-sale phrase, a word that names listings (listings, ads, URLs, links) or an order starting with "List" counts on its own; any other action verb needs a listing detail beside it (items, priced, distances, a <=/>= bound) or a brief kind word; a verb alone or a detail word alone stays research. Covered by tests/research/treeaudit.test.ts, describe "listing work needs an action on listings, not any verb": the b7772e titles the 2026-11-11 removal line names stay research, the listed-for-sale survivors and the car research 0c750f listing pieces stay covered, and the D8.2.1.1 branch keeps its district and sea-access leaves

title: research data overwritten in place with no copy to go back to
signal: a research file with fewer pieces or kept rows than the day before and no snapshot, journal line or log error that names the removal; a "tree" or "edit" log line that removes pieces with findings; a user asking where their plots went
cause: ProjectStore.save overwrote data/projects/<id>.json in place on every save with no record of what it replaced, data/handoff kept only the latest state and the research log held messages only, so the start-of-run repair that dropped 69 researched pieces of b7772e on 2026-11-11 (328 -> 201 kept plots) left nothing to restore from
prevention: every save appends one line to data/journal/<id>.jsonl with its reason and the full content of every piece and kept row it removes or replaces; a save that lowers the piece count or drops kept rows without a sweep first copies the stored file to data/projects/snapshots/<id>-<stamp>.json (newest 5 kept); a save that removes a researched piece is refused with an error in the research log unless the caller passes userAction delete, re-decompose, restore or loop; node src/frl.mjs restore <id> [snapshot | --before <ISO>] brings a snapshot or the journal state back while the research is not running. Covered by tests/store.test.ts (a removing save writes one snapshot and journals the removed content; an automatic removal of a researched piece is refused; a user-reason removal passes; the 6th snapshot drops the oldest; restore brings back the node and row counts; journal replay restores a removed node's findings) and tests/journal.test.ts (diff, undo and replay on the real node and row shapes). Because the store refuses, a start-of-run repair may never drop a researched piece: narrowRegions marks an off-scope researched leaf covered (coveredBy off-scope, findings kept) and removes only unresearched ones, using the same researched() predicate as the store (tests/research/treeaudit.test.ts, and the engine test that starts a run over such a leaf without a refusal)

title: an excluded word matched inside a longer word and dropped the suppliers asked for
signal: a genuine supplier of the asked kind is missing from report.deliverables while its page passes every kind, anchor and wholesale check; the brief's not list holds a short word (retail, part) that is the start of a longer common word (retailers, partners)
cause: entityDeliverables dropped a page when plain(pageText).includes(phrase), so the excluded word retail hit retailers, the customers a wholesaler names; b2f5b7 lost brasco.nl and vintage-clothing-wholesale.com
prevention: excluded phrases go through the shared whole-word helper wordMatch (Unicode letter boundaries, whitespace runs inside phrases); tests/research/acceptance.test.ts "a wholesaler page naming retailers as customers is not dropped by the not phrase retail" uses the real brasco.nl row and the real dustfactoryvintage retail paragraph

title: an entity-list region rule that let every source through and said nothing
signal: brief.regions is set and brief.located is false, every source passes the pre-model screen, and neither the research log nor the delivered rows say that the suppliers are outside the asked country (b2f5b7: 54 of 54 sources admitted, 3 of 3 delivered rows NL/FR/PL for a CZ ask, no region word anywhere)
cause: onConcept returns true before reading any country when located is false (deliberate: for an entity list the asked place is where the result is used), and the relaxed rule removed the measurement together with the drop
prevention: when a gate is relaxed on purpose, keep the measurement: regionVerdict labels each source in, ships to, names or outside the asked regions, engine.onConceptOnly logs the count of sources kept from outside, and each entity deliverable carries its region label; tests/research/brief.test.ts "region verdict for an entity list", tests/research/engine.test.ts "counts and names the sources kept from outside the asked country" and tests/research/acceptance.test.ts "marks each delivered supplier with its region verdict for an entity list and delivers the same rows"

title: table limits set aside rows that pass every hard criterion
signal: 18 live imovirtual.com plots of b7772e (500-18,000 EUR, Portugal, sea <= 20 km, 10-12 camping months, all pages active) pass every hard criterion of the research, yet none is in candidates.kept: 7 at 500-3,800 EUR fell under the implausiblyLow MAD cut (4,439 EUR) and 11 at 17,000-18,000 EUR fell past kept.slice(0, MAX_KEPT) of the 1,453 rows that passed the screen (docs/audits/recover-b7772e.md section B)
cause: buildCandidates moved every implausiblyLow-flagged kept row to toCheck and sliced kept at MAX_KEPT without asking whether the row passed every hard criterion of the research (clean screen verdict, asked country, not gone, coast <= 20 km and >= 10 camping months when recorded on the row)
prevention: passesEveryHardCriterion exempts such a row from both table limits: implausiblyLow only flags it (the lowCut stays visible on the kept row) and the MAX_KEPT cut applies only to rows that fail a hard criterion; tests/research/candidates.test.ts "rows that pass every hard criterion are never set aside or capped (recover-b7772e)" builds real rows from the URLs and prices in docs/audits/recover-b7772e-urls.txt

title: server started without a heap limit and crashed on Node's default ~2 GB heap
signal: heap OOM (JavaScript heap out of memory / FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit) in data/logs/server.out while the server was loading research data, on a machine with plenty of free RAM
cause: every launch path (frl start spawn, launchd plist, Windows logon task, systemd unit, start.command) started node with the default max-old-space-size (~2 GB on 64-bit), so a large research exhausted the old space and the process died
prevention: every launch path passes --max-old-space-size=4096 to node before src/server.mjs, defined once as NODE_HEAP_FLAG in src/service.mjs and reused by src/frl.mjs and the three service definitions; tests/frl.test.ts and tests/service.test.ts assert the flag precedes server.mjs in the frl start spawn args, each service definition and start.command. Note: an already installed launchd plist only picks this up after node src/frl.mjs install is rerun

title: a supported grade with no sourced fact behind it, and weak pieces never re-researched
signal: pieces graded supported whose claims are all assumptions: b2f5b7 D4.1 ("0 brands present") and D4.2 (six assumed SKU counts) stored as supported with attribution detail "0 of 0 claim(s) carry a quote found in the cited source"; a re-run of the same research never re-attempted its weak or unsupported leaves
cause: attributionSummary scored a claim set with zero factual claims as share 1 and passed, so the attribution check passed with nothing sourced and the grade ladder could reach supported; and engine.run reset only failed/researching pieces to pending, so weak and unsupported leaves were left as they were on every later run
prevention: attributionSummary passes only when at least one factual (non-assumption) claim exists and every numeric claim is attributed (share 0 and passed false when factual is 0), so verifyFinding can no longer grade such findings supported; engine.run resets weak/unsupported leaves to pending and re-researches them, keeping the previous finding and status and restoring them when the re-attempt grades lower by GRADE_RANK. Covered by tests/research/verify.test.ts (the verbatim b2f5b7 D4.1 and D4.2 findings grade weak, not supported) and tests/research/engine.test.ts (a second run re-attempts a weak leaf; a worse re-attempt keeps the old finding); proof counts over the stored b2f5b7 findings: old grading weak 6 / supported 5 / unsupported 1, new grading weak 8 / supported 3 / unsupported 1

title: the self-improving loop stopped on a plateau instead of running for the hours the user chose, and steered at a check already at 100%
signal: find-appropriate-plots-to-buy-fo-b7772e started the improve loop with ~24 h, ended at 2026-11-12T20:57Z with "plateau: 12 trials in a row...", resumed after restart 22:15Z with 22.8 h left and ended again 22:44Z on a plateau; the 22:25Z stall message named "At least 50 valid items" at 100% as the weakest check while the score was 0.807 and only 14 of 30 pieces passed
cause: commit 0edee7a made ProjectImprover.loop break on PLATEAU_TRIALS=12 non-kept trials, overriding the user's deadline, and stallCheck picked the weakest acceptance check by raw value even at 100%, so steering aimed at a check that cannot gain while the real deficit (pieces not passing) was ignored
prevention: a plateau only switches steering (the recorded stall flips to stalled, as the stall path does) and the loop runs until the deadline, the user stops it, or nothingLeftToGain says every acceptance check is at 100% and every piece passes (that stop reason says exactly that); stallCheck targets the lowest check below 100%, else names the failing pieces, never a check already at 100%; tests/research/improve.test.ts "keeps looping through a plateau while time is left", "never steers at a check already at 100%" and "nothing left to gain" cover it

title: the improve loop discarded data that served the purpose and reverted whole proposals for naming regions outside the brief
signal: find-appropriate-plots-to-buy-fo-b7772e (brief regions PT ES TR VN, price cap 20000 EUR): of the last 200 improve trials 82 were provider-outage and the reverted ones (32 reverted-piece, 31 reverted-whole, 19 reverted-structure, 1 reverted-noise, 2 reverted-stopped, 13 no-gain, 1 no-new-evidence) threw away every listing the trial found; 18 of the 19 reverted-structure trials failed only on outside-regions after mixing Italy/Greece/Croatia/Bulgaria into pieces that also targeted TR/VN portals (sahibinden, hepsiemlak, batdongsan, chotot); no-gain pieces were retried with the same queries
cause: a trial was kept only on a score gain above the noise floor, so reverted-whole/reverted-noise discarded new candidate rows; the structural gate reverted any proposal naming an out-of-region country instead of trimming it to brief.regions; and nothing recorded which queries a piece had already used, so repeats were re-researched
prevention: proposals are trimmed to the allowed regions before the structural gate (trimProposalRegions), new candidate rows that pass every hard criterion are merged into the research and recorded as kept-data even when the text change is reverted or the score sits inside the noise floor (dataGain/mergeDataRows, counted as a gain by plateauCheck/stallCheck/restEnds), and per-piece used queries are recorded and refused on repeat (usedQueries/sameQueriesAgain) while the proposer is told the purpose, the allowed regions, the price cap and the countries native languages; tests/research/improve.test.ts and tests/research/prompts.test.ts cover it

title: the loop kept a contact page as a new listing
signal: b7772e loop trial 2026-11-13 01:29 recorded kept-data with https://terrenos.es/en/contactar/propietario/422967 (an owner contact form) as a plot that passes every hard criterion
cause: passingHardRows screened rows by price and region only and never asked whether the URL is a single listing page; looksLikeListing accepted /contactar/ paths with a numeric id
prevention: passingHardRows requires looksLikeListing; NOT_A_LISTING rejects contact paths in the asked languages (contact, contacto, contactar, contato, contatti, kontakt, iletisim, lien-he)

title: an exclusion word was ignored when the page kind was unknown, so a furniture ad passed as a plot
signal: b7772e loop trial 2026-11-13 02:28 kept https://www.olx.pt/d/anuncio/contador-consola-aparador-movel-armario-oriental-olmo-rustico-IDFQRgo.html (a cabinet) as a plot that passes every hard criterion
cause: screenItem checked kind.not only when the source page kind was known; otherwise one shared word (rustico) made isKind true; the plot template had no furniture words in kind.not
prevention: kind.not exclusions apply on every path; the plot template excludes furniture words (movel, moveis, mueble(s), armario, aparador, consola, mobilya, furniture)

title: the router learned per provider, kept calling a deprecated model, re-admitted a benched provider at full load and read rate limits as unreliability
signal: data/logs/model-calls.jsonl (1,351 calls, 2026-11-02..04): 38 calls answered cloudflare HTTP 410 Model has been deprecated over three days and 0 cloudflare calls worked; groq shows 36 of 111 calls failed, every one HTTP 429 or 413; a cohere HTTP 500 whose request id holds 413 and a cohere 422 saying generated are counted as rate limits; a provider's pass rate does not move when FRL_<ID>_FAST_MODEL changes its model
cause: OutcomeBook keyed on provider|purposeClass, so a new model inherited the old model's record, and purposePlan ranked first research attempts (fast tier) with the deep model; switchModel knew only 404 as gone and a 410 is not retryable, so a model that could not be switched got no cooldown; a lapsed cooldown re-admitted the provider for every waiting call at once; providerStats divided by all calls and matched the bare substrings rate, limit, 429 and 413
prevention: each model is its own arm (key provider|model|purposeClass, rankRole modelRole); modelGone covers 410 and deprecated wording, and a gone model that cannot switch benches the provider 24 h with the env var to change; a lapsed cooldown is half-open and admits one trial call; reliability leaves capacity limits out; tests/llm/outcomes.test.ts "two models of one provider keep separate posteriors, and the legacy key still works without a model", tests/llm/ranking.test.ts "rankRole uses p[modelRole] for the posterior and the shown model", "purposePlan research order uses the fast model's posterior, since first research attempts run on the fast tier" and "providerStats does not lower reliability for 429/413 and does not count \"generate\" as a rate limit", tests/llm/router.test.ts "the real cloudflare 410 deprecated error benches a provider whose model cannot switch, for 24 h, naming the model and the env var", "benches a provider whose deprecated model is pinned by an env override, and retires and switches the model when the provider can", "half-open admits one trial call after a bench lapses and closes on success", "half-open re-opens on a failed trial: 10 min after one compute error or one timeout, the normal cooldown otherwise" and "a second call waits for the trial instead of failing when every provider is cooling, and gives up after the wait limit"

title: a whole-engine audit found the same failure in four layers: the headline counted fits the verifier had not confirmed
signal: one number told three ways on the same research (b7772e: verdict 273, count 266, proposal 273 'count toward your result'); a memo check that calls the table's own count a contradiction; an API that answers a foreign Host or a cross-site Origin; a loop whose re-measure never re-runs anything
cause: rules fixed in one stage were not carried to the stages that report the same number (row A1 returned through the verdict text, the proposal, the workbook and the UI), and some defects only show when the whole engine is read layer by layer against real data
prevention: a periodic whole-engine audit by layer on real data (docs/audits/engine-audit-2026-11-12.md: 70 findings, each fixed only after a failing test on its real input); tests named in the three fix commits, among them candidates 'the verdict headline counts fits that are confirmed', server 'refuses cross-site writes and a foreign Host on this computer', lifecycle 'the re-measure researches the changed piece again'

title: a kept-data trial line led with the raw new-row count and its hosts, so a truncated UI showed a gain the kept rows did not support
signal: b7772e kept-data trial 2026-11-13 04:29 (node D8.2.1.1.b.1): detail read '+126 listings from academia.edu, apify.com, bestrealestateplanet.com, ... , 4 pass every hard criterion' while only 4 imovirtual.com plots were kept; a UI that cuts the line shows '+126 listings from academia.edu'; the 05:18 D17 trial showed the same shape with '+232 listings' and 3 fotocasa.es plots kept
cause: dataGain built the detail string from the fresh rows first and the passing count last, so the leading hosts named rows that were never kept and the kept hosts appeared only after the truncation point
prevention: the detail leads with the kept rows and the hosts of the passing rows only, then the raw count ('+4 listings that pass every hard criterion (imovirtual.com); 126 new rows found in total', or 'no new listing passes every hard criterion; ...' when none pass); tests/research/improve.test.ts 'collects the new listing rows and keeps only those that pass every hard criterion', 'keeps new passing rows on a reverted text change and logs them in plain words, counting the trial as a gain', 'names the kept listings and their hosts first when most fresh rows come from non-listing hosts (b7772e 2026-11-13 04:29 trial)' and 'names the empty kept set first when no fresh row passes (b7772e 2026-11-13 05:18 trial shape)'

title: new keys reach the router; NVIDIA uses models that are still served
signal: 2026-11-13 measurements on build.nvidia.com: meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct, meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct → HTTP 410 end of life; openai/gpt-oss-120b, deepseek-ai/deepseek-v3, 01-ai/yi-large → not in /v1/models or 404; openai/gpt-oss-20b → no answer in 120 s; WORK: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b (JSON in 9 s), nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b (JSON 5 s), mistralai/mistral-large-4-1t-a52b (8-120 s, unreliable). NVIDIA provider failed 12 calls in a row and rested 60 min with two valid keys. Separately, adding a 2nd GROQ key at 14:30 (POST /api/keys/reload ran; status shows groq keys=2) did not lift the provider bench; groq stayed 'daily quota or credit used up; waits for the daily reset' for ~10 h.
cause: NVIDIA preset listed only deprecated/unavailable models. Router's provider-level cooldown/streak maps (cooldownUntil, cooldownReason, failureStreak, streakBenches) keyed by provider id survived reloadKeys; restoreCooldowns re-benched from model-calls ledger on restart without checking if key count had increased.
prevention: NVIDIA prefer/fast/deep/fallbackModels updated to three served models. Router.forgetBench(providerId) deletes all provider-level rest/streak state. reloadKeys calls forgetBench for each changed keyEnv and logs lifted benches. restoreCooldowns records provider.keyCount on failed ledger rows and skips restore when current keyCount > row.keys (rows without keys restore as before). restoreCooldowns also records the model on failed rows and ignores failures on models no longer selected by the provider when rebuilding failure streaks (rows without model count as today); single-row model-gone restores apply the same model check. Covered by tests/llm/router.test.ts 'ModelRouter.forgetBench', 'ModelRouter.restoreCooldowns key count', 'ModelRouter.restoreCooldowns model-aware streak' and tests/app.test.ts 'App.reloadKeys lifts bench on key change'.

title: every clause becomes a checked criterion (checklist model)
signal: decision.mjs kept a criterion only if its measure was in MEASURES (price plus plot/glamping quantities) and 2 of 3 samples used the identical measure|op key; result on live researches: suppliers b2f5b7 agreement {samples:3, proposed:0, kept:0}, cars 0c750f proposed 1 kept 0; every clause in decisionModel.missing; so 'proven good quality', 'assortment', named brands, 'engine information', 'usage trends', 'recently posted', 'highest price/value ratio' never checked, acceptance only tested count/live/range/kind
cause: the decision model only accepted criteria with measures in MEASURES; clauses without a measurable quantity (brands, quality, assortment, delivery, engine info, posting date, price/value ratio) were dropped into missing and never verified per item
prevention: new checklist.mjs module turns each clause into yes/no questions judged on its own page; proposeChecklist samples 3x, clusterChecklist groups by clause then meaning (Jaccard >= 0.5), keeps majority; judgeItem checks each question against page text, requires quote evidence; checklistSummary computes hardPass/unknown/softYes; DecisionModeler now builds checklist alongside criteria, stores in decisionModel.checklist, modelText prints it; dryrun shows checklist; MEASURES criteria unchanged for plots regression

title: hard-coded host names in directory detection and wholesale filter leaked into universal engine
signal: entityDeliverables hard-coded 'europages', 'kompass', 'wllw.net', 'visable' in readEntityWebsite and WHOLESALE_SIGNAL regex plus /wholesale/i.test(kindLabel) branch; tests asserted wholesale filter behavior
cause: the directory detection was implemented by host name instead of by JSON-LD structure (ItemList or ≥3 Organization/LocalBusiness nodes pointing to same-host profiles), and the wholesale requirement was baked into acceptance instead of coming from the checklist model
prevention: a page is a directory by structure only; an entity's own website is a url/sameAs on a different host than the directory page; the checklist model judges kind-specific requirements from the question's clauses; tests use fixtures (Europages HTML + single Organization HTML) to prove the structural rule; grep for host names in src/ must return nothing

title: checklist verdicts recorded but not used for acceptance; research marked done when short of asked items; memo not marked provisional when contradicted
signal: checklist verdicts (item.checks) are recorded but acceptance still uses only count/live/range/kind checks; research phase becomes 'done' even when valid items < asked items; memo states items found but acceptance shows K < N or hard checklist items at 0%
cause: acceptance evaluation used qualifies() based on live/listing/range/purpose only, ignoring the per-item checklist verdicts; phase transition to 'done' did not check validCount vs totalAsked; planActions did not cross-check memo claims against acceptanceResult
prevention: AcceptanceChecker.evaluate now requires all HARD checklist checks to be 'yes' for an item to be valid (unknown/no = fail); soft checks rank valid items; per-hard-check pass rates shown in acceptance checks; research phase set to 'short' with 'N asked, K valid' summary when K < N; planActions marks memo 'provisional' and lists failed hard items when acceptance contradicts memo

title: checkAcceptance called wrong modeler.build signature; rebuild made the decision model worse; degenerate models recorded as cases
signal: checkAcceptance called this.modeler.build(question, guidance) but the app injects a DecisionModeler whose build takes a project; rebuild with 0 criteria replaced a model that had criteria; decisionModel with no kind and no criteria recorded as a case and polluted future researches
cause: engine wired with ChecklistModeler in tests (build(question, guidance)) but app wires DecisionModeler (build(project, {force})); DecisionModeler.build did not guard against weaker rebuilds and did not filter degenerate models from cases.record
prevention: checkAcceptance uses project.decisionModel.checklist directly (single source); DecisionModeler.build carries stored kind/criteria when new aggregate has no kind or fewer kept criteria; isDegenerate guards cases.record; tests wire DecisionModeler-shaped modeler; covered by tests/research/engine.test.ts (checklist from decisionModel) and tests/research/decision.test.ts (rebuild keeps stored kind/criteria; degenerate not recorded)

title: a model reply wrapped in an object crashed the checklist judge and ended a research in error
signal: live cars rerun ended phase error: replies.map is not a function, while 30 items were valid
cause: ChecklistJudge treated reply.data as an array; free models often wrap a JSON list in an object such as {answers:[...]}
prevention: replyList reads a bare list or the first list inside an object, and anything else as no answers; covered by tests/research/checklist.test.ts (answers wrapped in an object)

title: checklist items tested collection clauses per item and missed code-measured values
signal: live cars 0c750f: per-item checklist asked 'Does the page list at least 20 cars?' and 'Does the page state cars are within 300 km?' (collection clauses a single page cannot answer) → all 'unknown' → every item failed hard checks; a spare-part page (headlight) passed as valid; price in CZK and distanceKm from Prague were on the row but went to page judge as unmodelled
cause: checklist prompt generated whole-sentence and count clauses; no check asked whether the page is one item of the asked kind; the distance code measures per row never reached the delivered items or the checklist
prevention: checklist prompt keeps only item-level questions with short-phrase clauses and drops count clauses and price limits (the acceptance value range converts currencies); ChecklistJudge asks the page judge one hard kind question built from decisionModel.kind label and exclusions; MEASURES gains distanceKm, carried from the table row to the delivered item and answered by code, never by the judge; CHECKLIST_VERSION bumped; covered by tests/research/checklist.test.ts (item-level checklist with a kind check) and tests/research/candidates.test.ts (distance handed to the expected-result check)

title: judge replies did not bind; clustering by clause text lost meaning; count check used stale validCount
signal: cars 0c750f: 26 of 40 page-judge calls returned ok, every item check 'unknown'; checklist contained invented 'Does this <clause>?' fallbacks and duplicate questions with different wordings per sample never reached majority; acceptanceResult.validCount=0 but count check 'At least 20 valid items' said 100% passed
cause: ChecklistJudge sent full 'clause|question' IDs to the model but the model rewrote them, so replies never matched; clusterChecklist grouped by exact clause text so short-phrase clauses worded differently per sample never reached majority and the fallback 'Does this <clause>?' was kept; recomputeAcceptanceValidity recomputed validCount but the count check used the stale value from before the checklist decided validity
prevention: ChecklistJudge sends short IDs (q1, q2...) to the model and maps replies back by index, accepting id with/without spaces/quotes/case; clusterChecklist groups by question meaning (sameMeaning) across all samples, keeps a group only when a majority of samples proposed it, keeps one representative (most common wording, hard from majority, numeric from majority), deletes the fallback; recomputeAcceptanceValidity updates the count check value/passed/detail from the recomputed validCount and recomputes the score; CHECKLIST_VERSION bumped to 3; covered by tests/research/checklist.test.ts (q-id binding, clustering by meaning, no fallback) and tests/research/engine.test.ts (count check follows recomputed validCount)

title: checklist items stated the asked count instead of per-item quantities; acceptance judged only first 30 items; kind rejections not remembered
signal: decisionModel.checklist still has a count item: 'Does this listing include at least 20 cars and up to 80 as a trade-off?' [hard] — models ignore the prompt rule; every page answers no/unknown, so no item can be valid. Only the first 30 delivered items are judged (engine.mjs checkAcceptance items.slice(0, 30)); 19 of those 30 failed the kind check (spare parts ranked first), while the table has 283 rows that fit. 0 valid of 20 asked.
cause: 1) Count items were not filtered by code after clustering; 2) checkAcceptance had a hard limit of 30 items judged regardless of itemCount; 3) When the kind check answered 'no', the URL was not recorded so it was re-judged on every acceptance pass.
prevention: filterCountItems drops a qualitative checklist item that restates a count from the acceptance spec (askedCounts: itemCount and counts in the expected text, not the value range), applied when the checklist is used so stored checklists are cleaned too; checkAcceptance judges ranked items until itemCount are valid or JUDGE_PAGE_BUDGET pages are read, cached verdicts free; a kind "no" url is kept in project.kindRejected and skipped next time; covered by tests/research/checklist.test.ts (filterCountItems) and tests/research/engine.test.ts (judge budget, kind rejections)

title: a question that asks for a category of kinds (activity providers, contractors) paused or narrowed to one kind
signal: Four entity researches that each asked for 40 providers of a category in one place (2026-11-13): two paused in needs-understanding (the domain pages each named a different kind, so no term was supported by two hosts), one paused in needs-concept ("the 10 page(s) about \"activity provider\" do not call it the same thing"), and one passed with the kind narrowed to the single kind its pages agreed on ("item kind confirmed: atv tours"), so every other kind was outside the research.
cause: 1) The decision model had one kind with one vocabulary and no way to say the item is a category of several kinds; 2) the domain study, the concept card and its two-page rule all looked for one name the pages share, which a category does not have; 3) the purpose kind check kept only the category words found in the question and entity delivery anchored terms on the category label, so a page of one kind (no category word on it) could never be delivered; 4) the item count was read from the question only when the tree was built, after the domain study, so on a first run the domain was studied with no decision model and no kind.
prevention: kind.members: the decision model lists the kinds of a category, kept when most proposals name them (votedMembers, merged by a shared label or term), and their words join kind.terms; a category is grounded kind by kind (validateUmbrella: one query per kind, up to 24 pages, a kind is confirmed when two different sites carry one of its words, so a business name on two pages of its own site is not a kind word, kinds the pages name are added, at least two kinds must be confirmed, unconfirmed kinds are kept and named in the log); the item count is read from the question before the domain study so the decision model, with its kinds, exists when the domain is studied, and the study is ready when two sites name two kinds; the purpose kind check, entity anchors and the page judge accept any kind of the category; covered by tests/research/umbrella.test.ts

title: a never-judged item passed as valid; validity and verdict text computed in six places
signal: hardChecksPass returned true when an item had no checks (live + listing + inRange + purpose), so an item the judge never read (past JUDGE_PAGE_BUDGET, or continue on empty page text at engine.mjs ~1528) counted as valid. Valid was computed in three places (acceptance.mjs:687, engine.mjs judge loop, engine.mjs recomputeAcceptanceValidity) and the summary text in three places (engine.mjs ~1316, ~1759, ~2029); they drifted: live memo said '20 asked, 0 valid' while acceptanceSummary said 1 valid.
cause: Validity was decided by hardChecksPass (yes on every hard check OR zero hard checks) and qualifies, without tracking whether the judge ever ran. Each place recomputed validity and summary independently instead of sharing one verdict module.
prevention: New src/research/verdict.mjs is the single owner of item validity and verdict text. Exports itemTier (confirmed/rejected/to-confirm/not-judged), itemEvidence (belief/plausibility/open), verdict (tiers, validCount, asked, short, perCheck, vague, summary, sorted items), verdictInvariants. Every place calls verdict (or itemTier) instead of its own logic; hardChecksPass removed. Judge loop stops on confirmed count from itemTier; empty page text marks not-judged. Vague requirements surfaced (EvalGen criteria drift): when verdict.vague non-empty, emit one line and store on acceptanceResult.vague. Invariants run at end of checkAcceptance: (a) acceptanceSummary count equals confirmed items; (b) no confirmed item lacks yes on every hard id; (c) acceptance.itemCount set but no checklist. Any failure → acceptanceResult.provisional and one emitted line; never throw.

title: all-yes hard checks rescued a dead or out-of-range item, and the verdict overwrote the entity evidence link
signal: Review of the verdict branch (2026-11-16): qualifies() returned true whenever every hard check was yes, so a page that was not live, outside the value range or failing a purpose check became confirmed; one engine test passed only through it (its item page was shorter than MIN_LIVE_TEXT, so not live and never in range). verdict() stored belief and plausibility as item.evidence, the field that holds an entity's evidence URL: qualifies() then saw every item as an entity and the inspector would read the object as a URL on the next pass.
cause: 1) A worker fixed a failing test by widening the validity rule instead of the test page; 2) a new per-item field reused a name already carrying meaning elsewhere in acceptance.mjs; 3) the summary sentence was still built in three engine sites, two of them copies.
prevention: qualifies() is the base gate only (live, listing or entity, in range, purpose checks) and itemTier() rejects on a failed gate or any hard no, with no override field; the verdict stores its numbers as item.support; acceptanceSummaryOf(project) in verdict.mjs is the one summary sentence used by planActions and both done paths; the engine test page is long enough to be live, and asserts qualifies and valid; covered by tests/research/verdict.test.ts and tests/research/engine.test.ts

title: meaning was decided by words: cue lists, stems and token overlap
signal: The first purpose draft (2026-11-16) used cue lists for 'cheap and valuable', word stems and shared-token counts for goal traceability and same claim, token rules for same subject and word presence for source relevance. The owner rejected it: sources and forums do not use the explicit words, and word rules in one language break the universal engine.
cause: A lexical rule is the cheapest thing to write and to test, so it was used wherever two texts had to be compared by meaning. An absolute similarity threshold would have been the same mistake: one translation pair scored 0.635 on one embedding model and 0.919 on another.
prevention: Embeddings only rank, a grounded closed-set model judgement decides: retrieveThenVerify in src/research/semantic.mjs (shortlist by rank, lettered options shuffled per vote, a none option, majority or unknown). The embedder returns indexes and never a score (rank, medoid). src/research/purpose.json holds mechanisms and the Admiralty scales, no word list; tests/research/purpose.test.ts asserts it and answers the conflict vote in three languages with a fake.

title: a rule a model is only told to follow is broken
signal: Simulation on three researches (2026-11-16): the critique deleted the 'why still cheap' goal in 3 of 3 runs, quotes were paraphrased (0 of 14 scoping notes found on the page for suppliers), 9 of 17 ACH rows that mark every hypothesis the same were kept, and source grades came from the model's own label (an aggregator got 'A statistic').
cause: Each rule was an instruction in a prompt, with the model also holding the pen: it rewrote the whole tree, typed the quotes, built the matrix and graded its sources.
prevention: The model returns ids and operations, code holds the pen: the critique returns operations and applyOps refuses a drop of a mandatory node; ensureMandatory re-inserts the conflict goal with the five mechanisms after every critique; models pick sentence ids and quoteFromSpans builds the quote; diagnosticRows drops rows that cannot tell hypotheses apart; gradeFacts computes credibility from independent hosts and reliability from the host's history. The replay (scripts/purpose-replay.mjs) measures each one against the simulation baseline.

title: a yes or no without a quote counted, and a part priced at a twelfth of the median passed the kind check
signal: Live research 0c750f (2026-11-16): applyQuoteCheck kept an answer whose quote was empty, and winter tyres on rims at 2,000 CZK were judged 'yes' on the kind question among cars with a median of 25,000 CZK.
cause: The quote check only tested a quote that was present; the kind was one yes/no question a small model answers 'yes' to whenever the page names the item; no price statistic was consulted.
prevention: The judge answers with sentence ids and applyQuoteCheck turns a yes or no whose ids give no quote into unknown; the kind is a selection among closed options in its own call (kindCluster options A to E and U); hardenKind turns a kind yes below lowPriceCut of the candidate table into unknown; migrateChecks does the same for stored answers once in reground; the judge version is part of checklistFingerprint so old answers are not reused.

title: numbers, goals and a purpose direction the user never stated entered the tree unmarked
signal: Simulation (2026-11-16): thresholds nobody asked for (10 %, 30 days, 95 %, 500 m, 3 %), goals outside the request (financing, a marketing plan, certification), and a reversed purpose: a small shop needs a small minimum order, the tree asked for large capacity.
cause: The tree was free text from one model call, so an invented number looked like an asked one, and nothing compared a goal with the clauses of the question.
prevention: thresholdsOf: a number lives only in the structured threshold field and is 'asked' when the user's words state it, 'sourced' when the cited note's quote states it, otherwise an 'assumption' that is never a hard check; any other digit in a goal or question text is recorded as inventedNumber. traceGoal: each goal is selected against the retrieved clauses, hints, purpose and implications with a relation; no trace means 'proposed', a contradiction means 'conflict'. Implications are stored as inferred. openEntries lists all of these for the user; engine.confirmTree (next pull request) is the only way past them.

title: a price outlier decided the kind by itself and hid the bargains the research looks for
signal: Lead review of the purpose branch (2026-11-16): hardenKind turned every kind 'yes' below lowPriceCut into unknown. On the 0c750f fixture the cut is 13,100 CZK with a median of 25,000 CZK, so real cars offered at 10,000 to 12,000 CZK could never be confirmed, and those are exactly the cheap and valuable items the owner asked for.
cause: A statistic that only says 'unusual' was used as a verdict. It was written against one case (tyres on rims at 2,000 CZK) and never checked against the low-priced real items in the same table.
prevention: A statistic may trigger a judgement, never replace it: below the cut, hardenKind runs a second kind judgement (judgeKindAgain: 3 votes, fast tier, the closed options A to E and U, sentence ids) whose prompt shows the item's price and the median of its comparables; A keeps the yes and its quote, B to E give no, U or no majority gives unknown; at or above the cut, or with no cut, nothing changes and no call is made. lowPriceStats is the one place that computes the cut and the median, and the engine caches the second judgement per item, cut and median. Tests: the tyre item answered B is no and rejected, a car at 10,000 CZK answered A stays yes and confirmed, no call above the cut (tests/research/verdict.test.ts, tests/research/checklist.test.ts, tests/research/engine.test.ts).

title: the score said 100% while 0 items were confirmed; cancel did not stop judging; a crashed run said nothing
signal: live cars 0c750f on 8dfaa95: summary 0 of 20 confirmed, count check 1.0 '89 of 207', score 1, memo '1 of 20'; 446 model calls after POST /cancel; engine.start swallowed every run error
cause: evaluate judged validity before any page was read (unjudged items confirmed), the final recompute had no caller, the memo was written before the last acceptance check, the judge loop never checked cancellation, start() caught and dropped errors
prevention: evaluate always passes the checklist (unjudged = not-judged); checkAcceptance ends with recomputeAcceptanceValidity; synthesize checks acceptance before writing the memo; scoreOf in verdict.mjs is the only score formula; verdictInvariants compares count check, score and memo with the verdict; the judge loop checks cancellation; run() ends a cancel as phase cancelled and start() records any other error as phase failed

title: deeper reads after judging ran silently with no limit, also for items a hard no had already rejected
signal: suppliers b2f5b7 on 106f9d2: 'judging pages: 20 judged' then 11 minutes with no log line while ~120 judge calls succeeded; the stall watcher fired
cause: checkAcceptance reads up to 3 same-host pages per unknown hard check per item with no page budget, no progress line, and for items already rejected by a hard no; hints turned into 8+ hard checks multiply it to ~2,000 possible judge calls
prevention: deeperOrder skips rejected items and items with nothing unknown and reads the closest-to-confirmation first; DEEPER_PAGE_BUDGET 60 per acceptance check; a progress line every 10 pages and one line when the budget stops it

title: a check read prose with a pattern and reported a mismatch that was not there; a contract a model was only told was broken again
signal: Audit of #190 and #191 on main 106f9d2 and the live replay of 2026-11-16 (data/replay): verdictInvariants reported 'memo acceptance text mismatch' for a memo that matched, because its pattern stopped at the first ')' of '(open: c)' and because a run that is not short writes 'hard checks at 0%' instead of the summary. The suppliers question asks for 'the highest price/value ratio, proven good quality' and the cheap-and-valuable vote said no 2 of 2 (cost null). Numbers the user never stated stayed in free text: suppliers 2, plots 8, against a target of at most 1. The car replay used 37 of 40 scoping calls.
cause: The memo check parsed the sentence back out of the memo text instead of comparing the value code had stored. The conflict contract defined cost as 'a low price', so a clause that trades price against value did not fit it. 'A number goes only in threshold' was an instruction in the prompt with no validator behind it, and a thousands-separated number was read as two numbers, one of them invented.
prevention: A check compares stored values, never text it parses back: planActions stores acceptanceContradiction with acceptanceContradictionKind ('short' or 'hard-checks'), and verdictInvariants compares the stored sentence with acceptanceSummaryOf only for 'short', and not when the memo is rewritten next (memoNext). A contract defines its terms by meaning: cost is a clause that limits, minimises or trades off what is paid, including the most worth per unit of money; one clause may be both cost and worth. A rule on model text is enforced by code: draftGoals, refineGoal and the critique's add reject a text holding a number that is in neither the user's words nor the cited quote nor the node's own threshold, ask once more, then settleNumbers puts each number still there to a closed vote of 3 (number-kind: A a quantity used as a limit, target or amount, B part of a name, model, code, standard or identifier, C a date or year). Only A is taken out of the text by moveNumbers and stored as an assumption threshold that is never hard; B and C stay (keptNumber) and are not counted as invented, so 'ISO 9001', 'Natura 2000' and '1.2 MPi' keep their digits; no majority leaves the text and inventedNumber records it. strayNumbers reads one written number as one number. STAGE_CAPS.scoping is 50.

title: the deeper page budget was spent on items that could never be confirmed
signal: Lead review of #192 (2026-11-16): deeperOrder skipped items with a hard no, but still listed items that fail the page gate (dead link, value out of range, failed purpose check) whenever a hard check was unknown, so part of the 60-page budget went to items whose tier stays rejected whatever the deeper page says.
cause: deeperOrder decided who is still open with its own rule on the checks, a partial copy of the verdict, instead of asking the verdict for the tier.
prevention: One owner for 'can this still be confirmed': deeperOrder takes the checklist, the kind and the acceptance spec the engine already has and keeps only items whose itemTier (with hardIdsOf, both from verdict.mjs) is 'to-confirm', still ordered by the fewest open hard checks first. Test: a dead-link item, an out-of-range item and an item with a failed purpose check, each with an unknown hard check, are not read (tests/research/deeper.test.ts).

title: requirements split at every comma, the goals of the key clauses dropped as restatements, and a price-only conflict branch with domain content in the engine
signal: Suppliers replay on main a9b5adb (2026-11-16, data/replay/suppliers-1-tree.json): the question was cut at every comma, so a list of four example brands became four requirements and four goals, each with obstacles that make no sense for the asked stock; the goals of 'highest price/value ratio' and 'proven good quality' were dropped with the reason 'only restates what was asked'; the tree stage stopped at 90 of 90 calls before every goal was refined; the conflict vote answered no, so nothing modelled value against cost.
cause: Structure was read from form or from one example: punctuation decided what a requirement is; a goal that restates its clause was treated as noise although it is that clause's goal; value against cost existed only as one price-specific branch whose five mechanisms were domain content stored in the engine; the tree budget was one fixed number whatever the number of goals.
prevention: Punctuation only gives pieces with ids; a vote on piece ids groups them into requirements (groupSpans in anchorsOf), and without a majority the split is kept and logged. The first version failed live on f462255 (same day): a majority was counted only on two identical whole groupings, which free models rarely give, and a piece can hold two requirements with no punctuation between them. So a piece of at least 3 words is first put to a vote on whether it holds more than one requirement, with the split point accepted only as an exact substring at a word boundary (splitPiece, splitPoint), and the grouping is the consensus over the valid votes pair by pair (at least 2 valid votes). Connected components over majority pairs failed live too (da49584): that is single-link, and pairs chained the whole question into one requirement. Groups now merge only when every pair across them is put together by a majority of the valid votes (complete link, strongest first), and the split and grouping votes are stored on the tree (tree.requirements) so a produced tree shows what each step did. A vote over a whole structure is counted per element, never as one identical answer; a fake-only test of a voted step is not evidence that free models agree. The purpose budget is sized to the votes the stage makes (purposeCap). traceGoal keeps a goal that restates its clause (restates: true) and it is refined; only a question that restates is dropped, by a vote on question letters (measurableQuestions), with one more request for measurable questions, and a goal left without any is listed as not refined and its clause as not modelled. Whether the result consumes the asker's resources is voted (consumesVote); if yes or undecided the tree holds two protected goals fixed by code, the value side (EN 12973, how and why) and the total-cost side in the three phases of total cost of ownership (Ellram), where code sets the checker: code for what is paid, sources for other costs; valueForCost is computed by code. Tensions are pairs of the asker's own requirement ids, each pair counted on its own (tensionsAsked); ensureTensions builds the goal from the two texts only for voted pairs; explanations must cite a scoping note id (explainTensions), the one method alternative is added by code, and fewer than 2 cited explanations is an open research-gap entry. purpose.json holds only the Admiralty scales. The tree budget is 12 calls a goal, at least 60 (treeCap). A stopped worker's patch is reviewed line by line and its tests are run before any of it is kept: this one dropped the hints after grouping, logged nothing, set the budget after the tree was built, let a model write the fixed goal texts, dropped the number rule from refineGoal, and its replay test could not pass.

title: a research looked frozen while the router waited for quota, gave up, or kept a provider that needs payment on the route
signal: Measured 2026-11-16 over 3 h: one provider failed 177 of 513 calls (164 x HTTP 429 per minute), another 37 of 265, and a provider answering HTTP 402 (no balance) was still in the route order. The router wrote its waits and failures only to the app-wide model-call ledger, so the research log showed nothing while it waited or gave up. Review of the stopped worker's patch (2026-11-16): it kept the wait state on the router instance, so parallel calls reset each other's throttle; it replaced the router's single onWait callback from the engine; it excluded a payment-required provider for ever instead of 24 h; its own notice row became the provider's last ledger row and hid the 402 from the restore after a restart; and its phase summary sliced the shared 500-row ledger by offset, so it counted every project's calls.
cause: The router had no channel to the caller: one ledger for the whole app, no notion of which research a call belongs to, and no event when it waits or ends without an answer. State that belongs to one call or one research was kept on shared objects.
prevention: The router carries the caller's scope in AsyncLocalStorage (ModelRouter.scoped): every ledger row made inside a scope carries its project, and wait, give-up and payment events go to that scope's listener only. Wait notices are throttled per call (WAIT_NOTICE_MS) and wait lines per project (WAIT_LINE_MS); the payment exclusion is a dated entry (paymentUntil, 24 h) checked by available(), route() and the last-resort list, announced once per exclusion and restored silently after a restart. Every phase change goes through ResearchEngine.setPhase, which writes the summary from the rows of this project's scope. Tests: two scopes and two researches side by side see only their own events, lines and call counts; a 402 provider is excluded for 24 h, said once, and never used as paid fallback (tests/llm/router.test.ts, tests/research/engine.test.ts, tests/research/routerlog.test.ts).

title: the market screen dropped knowledge sources, scoping rested on one host, the replay ran without the user's hints, and a requirement no goal covered passed the replay
signal: Suppliers replay on main a9b5adb (2026-11-16): scoping kept 2 of 12 sources and all 4 notes came from one host; sources that explain how to choose or grade were dropped as 'off-market: describes another market'. Replays of the purpose-structure branch the same day: suppliers 3 kept, 9 dropped; the counter-examples with no market at all, library 2 kept and trail 3 kept; second opinion 1 of 3, 2 of 8, 0 of 2. The questions file had guidance '' for a research whose stored project holds the user's hint. A replay table passed while requirements had no goal: the third suppliers replay listed two requirements as not modelled and still reached needs-confirmation only because of other open entries.
cause: One judgement asked every source for the market it describes and code dropped every 'another market' answer, although a source that explains how to judge holds wherever it was written. The market letter is the answer free models disagree on most (re-judged live on the stored kept sources: the verdicts that flipped were the market letter, a missing sentence id and 'not informative'), so the same screen made the second opinion low; the replay also counted a second answer that never came, or that came from the same provider, as disagreement, and re-judged with the kind instead of the subject the first screen used. Perspectives were only what a model proposed, queries were searched as one fused list, so nothing counted hosts or perspectives. The replay read its inputs from a hand-kept file. notModelled was computed and never checked: nothing blocked confirmation and no metric read it; a goal's own claim of its anchor counted as coverage without the trace vote, and a goal merged away took its requirement with it.
prevention: A source on subject gets a closed role vote on the sentences the judgement saw (sourceRole: knowledge or market, 3 votes, quorum 2); relevanceReason applies the market check only to a source voted market, and an undecided role never drops. Every drop made by the market check stores the voted role, and the replay row 'roles' fails on a knowledge or role-less off-market drop. A value perspective and a cost perspective are fixed by code (fixedPerspectives: names and basis from the value and cost sides, a model writes only the phrases, one phrase by code when none answers); composeQueries gives every perspective a query before any gets a second. Sources are searched per perspective (findSources), so each kept source names its perspectives; diversityOf needs 4 distinct hosts across 2 perspectives, otherwise runScoping composes one more round (unused phrases, or new ones asked with the tried phrases shown), only while the scoping budget has room, and logs 'scoping thin: N hosts' with what it did. The scoping budget is sized to its votes (scopingCap). With --projects the replay takes question, hints and regions only from the stored project (replayInputs, storedEntry) and refuses a research whose project is missing. A requirement is covered only by a kept goal with a question that the trace vote put on it, directly or through an implication agreed on that requirement, and not through an implication when its own goal could not be refined (coveredAnchors); absorb keeps the requirement of a merged goal. tree.notModelled entries are open entries, confirmTree refuses while one is not dismissed (dismissNotModelled), needsConfirmation stays true even with confirmedAt set, and the replay row 'coverage' fails on a listed or a silent requirement. The second opinion is asked with the screen's own purpose and subject and the first role, and reports agree, disagree, not judged and same provider apart, with every row written to 0-scope-second.json. Stored replay outputs are golden fixtures: a metric is only trusted after it was run on a stored output that is known to be wrong and failed there. Two follow-ups from the lead's review of the same change: the screen asked whether a source is about the bare kind word, so for a question about software libraries every page about lending libraries and none about the asked thing looked alike (10 of 12 dropped as off-subject); the screening subject is now the kind with the grouped requirement texts of the research (askedSubject, screeningSubject), candidate subject labels still win when a table exists, and the replay draws requirements and purpose once (drawRequirements) and gives them to scoping and to the tree. Hints went through no grouping, so one hint listing six countries was six hint anchors; hints now pass the same splitPiece and groupSpans as the question's pieces (groupedPieces), stored in tree.requirements.hints. The coverage invariant stays on clause anchors. The queries had the same fault as the screen: composed from the kind word, they searched 'library' plus a phrase and found lending libraries. Without a candidate table the subject labels of the queries now come from the requirements (requirementSubjects): one closed-format call writes a phrase of at most 6 words per requirement, code keeps it only when every word stands in the requirements and one in its own requirement, asks once more otherwise, and uses a translation into a market language only when the embedder ranks it nearest to its own phrase among the research's phrases (a translation code cannot check is not used; the checked phrase is used in that language instead). The kind label is the fallback only when the call fails; table labels still win. A fix to what a stage judges is traced to what the same stage searches for.

title: every clause and hint a hard page question, 0 confirmed
signal: Suppliers b2f5b7: 0 of 20 confirmed, 25 rejected, hard 'brands similar to ...' unknown; cars 0c750f: 0 of 20 confirmed, hard 'listing is accurate and verified' unknown on 88 of 90. Every clause from the question and every hint became a hard page question; no goal-level decomposition, no checker diversity, no soft preferences.
cause: The purpose stages (scoping, purpose, decomposition) were implemented but only wired to scripts/purpose-replay.mjs. The live run still built the checklist from raw clauses via ChecklistModeler in decision.mjs:487, so every clause and hint became a hard page question with no code-enforced distinction between constraints and preferences.
prevention: Wire the purpose stages into the live engine: engine.studyDomain calls runScoping and stores project.scoping; engine.decompose builds project.purposeTree with buildPurposeTree before the piece tree and passes its goals to decomposePrompt; DecisionModeler.build uses the tree's questions (checker per question: page/code/consensus/statistic/official) for the checklist, not ChecklistModeler; hardness is decided by a closed vote on the requirement text (constraint|criterion), never a word list. The replay measures the targets. Covered by tests: decision builds checklist from stored-shape purposeTree fixture; hardness vote stub keeps limit hard, hint soft; supplier outside a location hint is not rejected; 'within 300 km' stays hard; composite goal combines by code; empty tree never replaces a good one; no tree -> old path unchanged.

title: one kind no on a home page rejected real suppliers for good, and one company was delivered twice
signal: Suppliers b2f5b7 live on ba474ac: 7 of 20 confirmed; vintagebulk.nl, palletliquidation.eu and ukusedclothes.com rejected by one kind judgement on the home page (quotes like "BEST SELLERS & NIEUW BINNEN"), stored in kindRejected for good; tumodakids sl, wakted bv and liberty global exports delivered from europages.nl and europages.it
cause: a single model answer on the least informative page decided the kind and was never revisited; vote() replaced the caller avoid list, so no second family was asked; entity keys were the profile url, which differs per language host
prevention: a kind no is read again on the company page by another family before it counts (engine.test "a kind no needs a second family"), kindRejected keeps the judge version, vote keeps the caller avoid list (semantic.test), directoryEntityKey joins the same company id across language hosts (entitypath.test)

title: a list research ended short of its count because the supplier pool came from one cached search
signal: Suppliers b2f5b7 live on ba474ac: 7 of 20 confirmed from 21 delivered; the hub search had run once per hinted country (15 pages each) on 2026-11-17 and was reused for 7 days; 8 of 28 pages were spam or off-topic
cause: searchHubs searched once and cached the result for a week, whatever the result count; nothing searched again when the run ended short
prevention: searchHubs runs rounds until the pool not rejected by the kind judge reaches 3x the asked count, snowballs queries from suppliers the judge accepted, pages directories, ranks pages by BM25 without dropping other languages, and ignores the cache when short (engine.test hub rounds)

title: real suppliers rejected as 'several items or a list'
signal: Suppliers b2f5b7 live on 80822d2: 15 of 20 confirmed; gradedwholesale.com, dropy.com.pl and five europages company profiles rejected by the kind judge, every one with option C 'several items or a list'
cause: the kind options were written for listing pages (one unit, a part, several items); a business page always shows many goods
prevention: kindCluster gives a business kind (kind.entity, set by briefOf when located is false) options about one business, a directory, an article and a wanted ad (checklist.test 'kind options for a research that looks for businesses'); witness in docs/audits/entity-kind-proof.md

title: the price trend was measured in local money, not in the buyer's currency
signal: Plots b7772e: every one of 322 Turkish plots failed 'real price trend above the EU average' at Turkey -10.7% a year after Turkish inflation (2024), although the user buys in EUR
cause: trendOf deflated the local house price index by the same country's inflation and compared one year against the EU; no exchange rate and no euro-area inflation were used
prevention: trendOf converts with Eurostat ert_bil_eur_a (statinfo=AVG, currency=<listing currency>, national currency per euro) and deflates by euro-area HICP; the check compares multi-year growth in EUR over the same years with the EU (site.test 'price trend in the buyer's currency', strategy.test trend checks)

title: a research crawled at one call a minute while a better provider was idle
signal: Suppliers b2f5b7 2026-11-18 05:17-05:42Z: 20 of 90 pages judged; every judge call went to pollinations with a 45 s queue wait while nvidia (91% of answers passing the gates against 76%) was ready; Gemini benched 24 h
cause: time per answer left out the queue wait of a paced provider, so a 49 s answer ranked as 4 s; when Gemini's other models rested for their daily quota, its last model (retired, HTTP 404) benched the provider for 24 h instead of until the quota reset
prevention: providerStats counts waitMs in spentMs (ranking.test 'counts the time a paced provider kept a call waiting'); benchGoneModel rests until the earliest quota reset of the provider's resting models (router.test 'rests a provider whose last model is gone only until ...')

title: a new decision layer replaced the stable criteria instead of feeding them
signal: PR #202 replaced the checklist built from the decision model (nodes, research data, criteria) with purpose-tree goals and made items hard only when traced to the user's literal words. Live suppliers b2f5b7: decisionModel.criteria = [], 26 checklist items all hard:false → nothing vetoes → '19/20 confirmed' while results do not fit. Plots: tree missing, report falls back to 3 generic checks.
cause: The purpose-tree layer was shipped as a replacement for the stable criteria layer instead of as an additional signal that feeds into it. No comparison gate existed to verify that the new layer produced the same or better results (criteria count, hard checks count, confirmed items that fit) on reference researches before it became the only path.
prevention: Ship new decision layers behind a comparison against the stable result on all reference researches (criteria count, hard checks count, confirmed items that fit) — never replace. A new layer must be additive: it provides extra goals/checks that the stable layer can optionally use, but the stable checklist from decisionModel.criteria + decisionModel.checklist remains the source of truth for validity. The comparison gate runs on every reference research in CI and fails if the new layer changes any confirmed item that fits or drops any hard check that the stable layer enforced.

title: A headline that averages unrelated checks hides the verdict; must-haves are non-compensatory (ELECTRE TRI veto, Roy 1991; conjunctive rule), preconditions are reported apart
signal: The acceptance score (arithmetic mean of all checks) was shown as the headline, so 8 checks averaging 0.5 looked like '50% met' even when 0 of 20 items passed every must-have; preconditions (count, links live, value range, mustMention) were mixed into the same list as hard checklist vetoes
cause: scoreOf() averaged checklist vetoes, kind checks, and preconditions together; the UI and report showed one flat list of checks with percentages, and the memo read the mean as the verdict
prevention: Headline is now confirmedCount/asked ('2 of 20 meet every must-have') plus plausibility ('up to N of M'). Checks are split: mustHave (hard checklist items, code criteria, kind) and preconditions (count, live, range, mustMention) — preconditions never enter the headline. Piece-grade log-odds is labelled 'research support', never 'probability' of the answer. UI and markdown report show headline, must-have table with per-check counts 'x of y judged items', and preconditions list separately. Replay script scripts/headline-replay.mjs prints old vs new headline and verifies criteria count and hard-check count are identical before/after.

title: a 2-of-3 vote could be one provider answering twice, and no change to the engine could be told from noise
signal: Audit B of 2026-11-17 (finding 4, checked by the lead in the code): vote() reached its quorum from two identical replies whatever provider gave them, and the router treats avoid as a preference, so with one free provider ready a vote was one model at temperature 0 asked twice; the test 'avoid grows per vote' passed while the guarantee did not exist. A split vote recorded a failed outcome for every provider that answered. Audit A (area 7) and audit B (section 8.2): every replay metric was structural or an agreement between two models, 'second opinion at least 80%' was percent agreement, each replay ran once, and no judgement had a labelled answer, so a replay table could pass while the logic was wrong (the failure already recorded for #190).
cause: A vote counted replies, not independent judges: nothing in vote() knew which provider or vendor a reply came from. The parts of the engine that decide (drop, veto, merge, reject, harden) read the vote value without asking how many judges stood behind it. Measurement had no reference: agreement between models was read as correctness, percent agreement as reliability, and one run as a measurement.
prevention: A reply counts toward the quorum only when its family is not yet counted; a family is one vendor and one serving stack (replyFamily, sameFamily in ranking.mjs; ModelRouter.familyOf and families), so two models of one provider, or one vendor on two providers, are one family, and a second reply from a counted family is stored as a repeat. With fewer than two families vote() returns { value, single: true } and agreed(result) is null: every caller keeps, orders or leaves open on it and none drops, vetoes, merges, rejects or hardens (the table in docs/specs/measurement.md section 6; tests per caller, and a single kind no leaves the item to confirm). A split records no outcome. Closed-choice votes go through closedVote: the options rotate by one letter per vote from a start hashed from the question, the ledger row carries task, letter and options, and a model whose letters fail a chi-square test against the even spread (alpha 0.01, at least 10 answers per option) is ranked down for closed-choice calls only. The start is hashed and not 0 because with a fixed start the right option sits under the first letters more often, and an unbiased model would fail the test. A change is proven on a reference set of labelled judgements on stored pages (scripts/reference-set.mjs: build, label-file, merge; a label needs a sentence id unless it is not stated), scored with Cohen kappa per task and provider, confusion counts and the wrong-no rate (scripts/measure.mjs score), and accepted only on a paired difference whose bootstrap interval, resampled by research, excludes 0 on held-out items, plus the quality gate (measure.mjs compare). Replays run three times (purpose-replay.mjs --runs 3) and report each rate with its count and spread; the second-opinion row prints kappa next to the percent. When a function takes a destructured option named like a method every object has (valueOf, toString), the default never applies: pairRuns took Object.prototype.valueOf until its option was renamed scoreOf. A default that applies when votes disagree must be the asker's own text, never a rule of form: the comma cut stood whenever two families tied on a grouping, so a list of examples was cut after its first item and a false tension goal followed (suppliers replays of 2026-11-18, 3 of 4). Pieces of one sentence now stay one requirement unless a majority of at least two families keeps them apart (groupSpans, sentencesOf), and the grouping of each family is stored on the tree, because a ledger that holds only counts cannot show why a live vote went one way.
